d: The court of palms and cypresses, with a temple in the middle consecrated to Diana, whose doors are closed. Agamemnon, and Ulysses accompanied by the Confederate Greek Princes, followed by Dukes, and the first Officers of the army, and numerous hosts of Soldiers, on both sides neatly arranged.
Calcante with a sheet in his hand, followed by Priests, and sayings.
Iphigenia followed by noble Donzelle and Greek soldiers, and sayings.

Camping of the Greeks on the shore of the sea with Greek fleet anchored. We see several ships, from the most magnificent of which, to the sound of majestic symphony, descends Achilles preceded by his Guards, and followed by Erifile, and the Army Tessala, which leads the Prisoners of Lesbos with the insignia, and spoils of the destroyed city.
Great Pavilion of Agamemnon, Agamemnon alone.
Pavilion of Agamemnon in different appearance. Erifile, and Arcade.
Agamemnon, then Ulysses accompanied by Confederate Princes, and Dukes of the army.
A small place in the middle of a horrid cliff, which shows a narrow bosom of the sea, with a small boat tied to the shore. Night with moon. Achilles alone.
Ifigenia, and Arcade with few Guards, is said.
Ulysses with numerous sequels of Greek Soldiers with torches lit, and sayings.
Pavilion of Agamemnon opened, which lets see part of the Greek camp. Agamemnon, and Achilles.
Dark bottom of ancient, and ruined tower, where is guarded Ifigenia. Ifigenia, then Arcade.
Great square in the center of the Greek camp. Statue of Diana in the middle with a burning plow before it. Agamemnon, then Ulysses.

The whole Greek army progressed neatly, lining up on both sides, and surrounding the field, following Ifigenia in white crowned with flowers, accompanied by Calcante, preceded by the sacred ministers, who carry on golden kisses the bandages, and the instruments for the sacrifice; it is followed by women, by Arcade, and by the other dukes of the Greek field.
Achilles furious after Tessali, making his way among the Greeks.
